herdrPlugins._comment: herdr-plugins: git-status, undo and cycle share one repo; keep their refs equal.
pi-sidebar's pane navigation (prefix+h/j/k/l in the herdr config); keep its ref with the pi-plugins pin.

Its build step runs terminal-browser's own installer: the app on the NUC (~/.local/share/terminal-browser, wrapper in ~/.local/bin), a redundant copy behind the cask on Macs. SKIP_SETUP stops that installer's `setup` from linking global agent skills; ~/.local/state/terminal-browser/skills-choice (managed) declines them for the app's own first-run setup.
Native macOS alerts; its build steps compile and install the helper app (~/Applications/Herdr Native Notify), which the managed LaunchAgent and ~/.local/bin wrapper run.
